# Independent ordinary Gemma CLI regression controls

All clocks, owners, source/build/check/publication/CI receipts are synthetic and
created in test temporary directories from explicit input data. They establish
portable admission/comparator behavior only; they qualify no model or engine.
The workload file copies the earlier published384/128 ID/full-decode golden.
Tests never download, load a model, run a binary or call the capture controller.

`expected.json` fixes arithmetic independently, including a process-correlated
case whose whole-owner95% interval is[-55,+80], despite a-10% pooled median.
It distinguishes whole-owner uncertainty from false pairing and request-IID
resampling. The legacy5%screen applies; no1%observer interpretation is made.
Published and uncommitted snapshot receipts use distinct synthetic measured
source/binary identities. A successful screen always leaves accepted
optimization false. No synthetic receipt is reusable as real qualification.
